Create a Cryptographic Provenance Manifest (capsule.json)

Source: R/manifest.R
create_capsule_manifest.Rd

Records a complete, tamper-evident provenance manifest for a computational R project. Captures schema version, Git commit/branch/dirty state, R/OS/locale metadata, resolved R packages, OS system dependencies, detected scientific toolchains, RNG kind and seed, SHA-256 hashes of inputs, scripts, container definitions, and output artifacts, numeric tolerance policies, and optional embedded reference snapshots. Computes a canonical SHA-256 content_digest and an optional keyed HMAC-SHA256 signature via openssl.

Usage

create_capsule_manifest(
  path = ".",
  scan = NULL,
  inputs = NULL,
  scripts = NULL,
  outputs = NULL,
  containers = NULL,
  entrypoint = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  rng_kind = RNGkind(),
  tolerances = NULL,
  metadata = list(),
  embed_snapshots = TRUE,
  max_snapshot_bytes = 262144L,
  key = NULL,
  output = NULL
)

Arguments

path

Path to the project root directory. Defaults to ".".

scan

Optional pre-computed rcapsule_scan object. If NULL, calls scan_project() on path.

inputs

Optional character vector of input data file or directory paths (relative to path or absolute).

scripts

Optional character vector of script/source paths. If NULL, automatically discovers R scripts, Quarto/Rmd documents, DESCRIPTION, renv.lock, _quarto.yml, .stan, .py, and requirements.txt.

outputs

Optional character vector of generated output artifact paths (files or directories) to record and verify.

containers

Optional character vector of container specification paths. If NULL, automatically includes any Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, and *.def files present at the project root.

entrypoint

Optional runnable entrypoint override (defaults to scan$entrypoint).

seed

Optional integer RNG seed to record and enforce during verification. If NULL, uses the first statically detected set.seed() literal if present, or NULL.

rng_kind

Optional character vector of length 3 from base::RNGkind(). Defaults to the current session's RNGkind().

tolerances

Optional tolerance configuration: either shorthand list(abs_tol = 1e-4, rel_tol = 1e-3) or structured list(default = list(abs_tol = 0, rel_tol = 0), files = list("out.csv" = list(abs_tol = 1e-3))).

metadata

Optional named list of extra publication metadata (e.g., title, authors, journal, doi).

embed_snapshots

Logical; if TRUE, embeds base64-encoded snapshots of small (<= max_snapshot_bytes) tabular/JSON/RDS outputs inside the manifest so numeric-tolerance verification can run even when original output files are absent from disk. Defaults to TRUE.

max_snapshot_bytes

Maximum size in bytes of an individual output file eligible for embedded snapshotting. Defaults to 262144L (256 KiB).

key

Optional secret key string for signing the manifest with HMAC-SHA256.

output

Optional file path to write capsule.json. If NULL, returns the manifest object in memory.

Value

An S3 object of class rcapsule_manifest.

Examples

tmp <- tempfile("rcapsule_manifest_")
dir.create(tmp)
writeLines("write.csv(data.frame(x = 1:3), 'out.csv', row.names = FALSE)",
           file.path(tmp, "run.R"))
write.csv(data.frame(x = 1:3), file.path(tmp, "out.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
m <- create_capsule_manifest(tmp, outputs = "out.csv", seed = 42L)
verify_manifest_integrity(m)
#> 
#> ── rcapsule Manifest Integrity: VALID ──────────────────────────────────────────
#> • Content digest: OK (db72768c9c18)
#> • Signed: FALSE | Signature check: "not verified"
unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
